notes: Caller for the SumKotitT macro from TulosMakrot.sas, which sums person-level results to household level via PROC SUMMARY (BY knro, ID list of household-constant variables, VAR measures, OUTPUT SUM=). Macro definition reproduced verbatim; called with KUTSMALLI=VERO and global &PAINO=ykor. Input is a small synthetic person-level table whose columns match the ID/VAR lists; PROC PRINT shows the summed household totals. Macro logic unchanged.
